programs.title: Come Dine with Me: Supersized
programs.desc: Non-professional chefs organize a party to which they invite the other participants of the program.The task is to impress others with your culinary art.Everyone is hoping for a reward.

programs.title: World's Most Secret Homes
programs.desc: Viewers will see original houses located in unique corners of the world.Among them are a cabin hidden in the mountains in Norway and a mysterious building built deep in the Brazilian forest.

programs.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programs.desc: Tailoring enthusiasts compete in the program, undertaking difficult tasks that test their skills, creativity and work under pressure.They are competing for the title of best non-professional tailor in the UK.

programs.title: The Great Kiwi Bake Off
programs.desc: Participants try to impress viewers and jurors with their culinary skills.Already in the first episode, the characters face quite a challenge.An additional difficulty is limited time.

programs.title: Inside Monaco: Playground of the Rich
programs.desc: The history of the principality where the most millionaires in the world live.The producers look behind the scenes of the royal palace and follow the life of Prince Albert II, who rules this unique country.

programs.title: Posh Hotels with Sally \u0026 Nigel
programs.desc: Actors Nigel Havers and Sally Lindsay visit four of the UK's most iconic and luxurious hotels.One checks in as a VIP, the other joins the ranks of employees.
